news_list.title: CBI Arrests Former Reliance Capital CFO Amit Bapna in Reliance ADA Group Probe
news_list.summary:
The CBI has arrested the former chief financial officer of Reliance Capital Limited, Amit Bapna, in connection with its ongoing investigation into Reliance ADA Group cases, officials said on Saturday.

The federal agency has alleged that Bapna, who served as the CFO of Reliance Capital Limited from August 2014 to December 2019, was "one of the key decision makers responsible for managing the financial affairs of the company".

"He allegedly facilitated and approved loans to intermediary and conduit companies despite being aware that such lending was contrary to RBI guidelines and the sanction conditions governing borrowings from Public Sector Banks," a spokesperson of the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) said in a statement. No immediate reaction was available from the company.

The CBI probe has shown that funds borrowed by Reliance Commercial Finance Limited (RCFL) were diverted through such intermediary entities to various Reliance ADA Group companies, including Reliance Capital Limited, Reliance Infrastructure Limited and Reliance Power Limited, thereby causing wrongful loss to the lending banks and corresponding wrongful gain to the accused persons and related entities, the spokesperson said.

Bapna was already in judicial custody in a case being probed by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) and was lodged in the Tihar jail here.

"In order to secure his custody in the present case, the CBI obtained a production warrant from the Special Judge for CBI cases, Mumbai. Accordingly, he was produced before the CBI Special Court, Mumbai, and arrested on 04.07.2026," the spokesperson said.

Bapna has been sent to four days of police custody by the special court, the spokesperson added.

The CBI has registered seven FIRs against Reliance Communications Limited (RCom), Reliance Home Finance Limited (RHFL), Reliance Commercial Finance Limited (RCFL) and Reliance Telecom Limited (RTL) based on complaints received from various public sector banks and the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC).

The CBI filed its first chargesheet in the RCom case on May 29 against 16 accused, including the company, five senior executives of RCom and 10 bank officials.

"With the arrest of Amit Bapna, the CBI has so far arrested six accused persons in the Reliance ADA Group cases," the spokesperson of the agency said.

news_list.title: Joey Chestnut chomps 66 hot dogs for his 18th Nathan's contest title
news_list.summary:
Crowds gathered in the sweltering heat Saturday to celebrate the United States' 250th birthday by watching famed competitive eater Joey "Jaws" Chestnut defend his world hot dog eating championship in Coney Island, where he downed 66 hot dogs in just 10 minutes. Miki Sudo defended her title as well in the women's division.

Saturday marked the 18th time Chestnut, 42, won the so-called Mustard Belt in just 21 appearances at the internationally televised Nathan's Famous Fourth of July hot dog eating contest. He beat out 13 competitors who came from around the country and world, trekking from the Czech Republic, Australia and South Korea.

Chestnut handily defeated the second-place winner, Patrick Bertoletti, 41, who ate 50 hot dogs, but fell short of his own 2021 record of 76 wieners and buns -- or approximately 7.6 hot dogs per minute.

Both champions said that the heatwave that scorched New York on Saturday -- bringing temperatures in Brooklyn to roughly 90 degrees Fahrenheit (32 degrees Celsius) during the competition -- made that much more difficult. On top of that, ESPN announcers said the humidity changed the consistency of the buns.

A large crowd braved the heat to watch the event, wearing foam hot dogs on their heads and standing outside the original Nathan's Famous restaurant that has been in Coney Island, Brooklyn, since 1972. The superfans who stood closest to the stage wore ponchos as protection in case a competitor threw up.

news_list.title: CBI arrests NHAI Shillong Project Director on Rs 12L bribery charges
news_list.summary:
SHILLONG, July 4: The Project Director (PIU) of the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI), Shillong, has been arrested by the CBI's Anti-Corruption Branch (ACB), Guwahati, for allegedly demanding a bribe of Rs 12 lakh from a contractor.

According to an FIR filed with the Deputy Inspector General of Police, CBI, ACB, Guwahati, Aanand Singh Chauhan allegedly demanded a bribe or undue advantage of Rs 12 lakh from a contractor to process an outstanding bill of Rs 13.38 crore.

Chauhan also allegedly instructed the contractor to pay Rs 4 lakh in advance for processing the outstanding bill.

Further, he allegedly directed the contractor to hand over the bribe money to a person identified as Punit in Guwahati.

The FIR further alleged that the NHAI officer sent an image of a Rs 10 note bearing serial number 74R394426 from his mobile phone to the contractor through WhatsApp, with directions to send the entire bribe amount of Rs 12 lakh to Jaipur through the hawala channel.

He also allegedly provided a contact number and the name 'Meena' as the contact person in Jaipur to receive the bribe amount through the hawala channel.

According to media reports, the two accused have been arrested and are on two-day CBI remand to enable the agency to carry out further investigation into the matter.

ai_analysis.full_text:
下一交易日方向判斷：偏空。受費半指數重挫 5.44% 與台積電 ADR 補跌影響，台股週一開盤將面臨沉重的估值修正壓力，建議避開高基期 AI 硬體股，嚴守資金控管。
【美股收盤重點】
美股科技股賣壓沉重，費半指數重挫 5.44%，顯示資金正因摩根大通示警 AI 算力支出放緩而加速從高估值板塊撤離。科技權值股控盤效應失靈，投資人應警惕市場對聯準會利率滯後效應的重新定價，這將導致估值修正趨勢延續。
【新聞驅動】
市場搜尋熱度轉向「群創」、「英特爾」與「營業額」，反映散戶在權值股劇烈震盪下，試圖尋找低基期標的以規避風險。這顯示市場決策帶寬已大幅收窄，資金情緒從追求成長轉向防禦，籌碼凌亂整理期正導致追漲殺跌的風險升高。
【國際與台股】
台灣現貨與 ADR 的高溢價屬於資金撤退下的被動產生，無法支撐補漲行情，台指期夜盤先行回檔 1.48% 已預示週一開盤的疲軟格局。儘管台股目前處於多頭趨勢且處於貪婪情緒，但面對權值股的補跌情緒，追價意願將大幅受挫。
【KOL與情緒】
目前的市場情緒顯示權值股籌碼已進入主力退場階段，散戶在缺乏方向感的環境中極易陷入波動陷阱。投資人需認清當前市場已從「攻擊模式」切換為「確認底部博弈」階段，高波動下的情緒反應通常會放大開盤的虧損效應。
【下一交易日觀察】
週一開盤的核心策略為「汰弱留強」，請以 3/2 基準線作為手中高基期 AI 硬體股的最後防線，跌破應果斷執行減碼而非盲目抄底。操作上應降低槓桿，靜待權值股止穩訊號，在市場確立估值底部前，防禦性配置是規避補跌風險的唯一解。

chart_orchestration.overall_summary: 本週末市場主軸由科技板塊的估值修正與資金避險需求主導。受摩根大通示警 AI 算力支出放緩影響，費半指數與 Nasdaq 科技股面臨沉重拋壓，市場情緒已從成長導向轉向防禦配置，具體表現為黃金避險需求增溫，且資金在權值股震盪時開始轉向社群熱議的個股進行防禦。建議在下週操作中，嚴控高基期 AI 硬體持倉，優先配置防禦性類股。

headline.teaser: 美股週五收盤，費半重挫 5.44%，台積電 ADR 下跌 2.27%。以目前現貨 2,445 元對比 ADR 換算後的 2,778.2 元來看，雖然帳面溢價高達 13.63%，但別被這個數字誤導。市場資金在週五出現明顯撤退，這溢價更多是「被動」產生的，週一開盤別想著補漲，反而要面對現貨補跌的壓力。台指期夜盤已先行回檔 1.48%，週一開低是基本盤。
